_help: Act 6 end, at Cairo's edge: the first sign (dust that won't settle), and where the countdowns stand. Then Act 7. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: Cairo. The sky over the city is the colour of old brass, and the dust hangs in the streets though there's no wind.

r_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
r_eleanor.line: It's here already, isn't it? Not him. Whatever comes ahead of him.

r_hassan.speaker: hassan
r_hassan.line: The first sign. Dust that will not settle. There will be others. We must find the thieves before the sky goes dark.

r_farid.speaker: farid
r_farid.line: Half the merchants will have closed by tomorrow. Fear is very bad for business.

r_idris.speaker: idris
r_idris.line: My contacts will be awake. Thieves always know when other thieves come to town.
